page.overview:
What is Stonepower?

Stonepower was an aspect of the Force that was only attainable by being in proximity to blue stone, a type of stone imbued with the Living Force. Attaining stonepower allowed individuals who were not Force-sensitive to be able to perform feats like telekinesis with the blue stone itself.
